roles.title: mathematics
roles.description: Solving, proving or checking mathematics: arithmetic word problems, algebra, calculus, probability, number theory, geometry, proofs.
examples: Solve for x: 3x^2 - 12x + 9 = 0
Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational
What is the integral of x e^x dx?
Find the derivative of sin(x) * ln(x)
How many ways can 8 people sit around a round table?
Compute the determinant of the matrix [[2,1],[5,3]]
If a train travels 180 km in 2.5 hours, what is its average speed?
What is the probability of getting exactly two heads in five coin tosses?
Show that the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared
Find all integer solutions of x^2 - y^2 = 15
Evaluate the limit of (1 + 1/n)^n as n goes to infinity
Factorise x^3 - 6x^2 + 11x - 6
Find the eigenvalues of [[4,1],[2,3]]
A sum of money doubles in 8 years at simple interest. What is the rate?
Prove by induction that 2^n > n for all natural n
What is the area of a triangle with sides 7, 8 and 9?
Solve the system: 2x + 3y = 13, x - y = -1
How many prime numbers are there below 100?

roles.title: programming
roles.description: Writing, explaining, reviewing or fixing source code and scripts in any programming language.
examples: Write a Python function that checks whether a string is a palindrome
Why does this JavaScript give undefined? const x = arr.map(i => { i * 2 })
Fix the bug in this Go code: for i := 0; i <= len(s); i++ { fmt.Println(s[i]) }
Implement binary search in C++
Explain what this regex does: ^(?=.*\d)(?=.*[a-z]).{8,}$
Write a bash script that renames all .jpeg files to .jpg
Refactor this class to use dependency injection
How do I read a CSV file with pandas and group by a column?
Write unit tests for this function
Convert this Java loop to a Java stream
What is the time complexity of quicksort and why?
My React component re-renders forever, here is the code
Write a Dockerfile for a Flask app
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable, how do I fix it?
Write a Rust function to reverse a linked list
Add error handling to this Node.js fetch call
roles.note: On small machines no code chat model beats Qwen3.5 of the same size; the specialists start at 9B (Ornith).

roles.title: databases and SQL
roles.description: Writing or fixing database queries (SQL), schema design, and questions answered from tables.
examples: Write a SQL query to find the top 5 customers by total order value
SELECT name FROM users WHERE created_at > '2026-01-01' GROUP BY city - why does this fail?
Join the orders and customers tables and show customers with no orders
Write a query for month-wise revenue from the invoices table
How do I find duplicate rows in PostgreSQL?
Create a table for employees with a foreign key to departments
Rewrite this subquery as a JOIN
Write a window function to rank salesmen by sales within each region
What index would speed up this query?
Count invoices per GSTIN where the tax amount is above 10000
Convert this SQLite query to MySQL
Get the second highest salary from the employee table

roles.title: law
roles.description: Legal questions: statutes, contracts, case law, rights and obligations, compliance, legal drafting (including Indian law).
examples: Is a verbal agreement legally binding in India?
What does section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act say about bounced cheques?
Draft a simple non-disclosure agreement between two companies
What are the grounds for divorce under the Hindu Marriage Act?
Can my landlord evict me without notice?
Explain the difference between a breach of contract and a tort
What is anticipatory bail and who can grant it?
Review this clause: the vendor shall not be liable for any indirect damages
What are the penalties for late filing under the Companies Act?
What rights does a consumer have under the Consumer Protection Act 2019?
Is a non-compete clause enforceable after employment ends in India?
What is the limitation period for filing a civil suit for recovery of money?
Explain force majeure in a commercial contract
What does the IT Act say about data breaches?
roles.note: No open law specialist beats a same-size general model (2026-10): SaulLM, Aalap, InLegalLLaMA and nyaya are below today's Qwen3.5; on Vals LegalBench the frontier leads (Claude Fable 5 88.6, GPT-5.4 86.0, Qwen3.8-27B 82.4). The brain answers, best with the statute text given to it.

roles.title: medicine and health
roles.description: Health and medicine: symptoms, conditions, medicines and doses, lab reports, clinical questions.
examples: What are the common side effects of metformin?
My blood test shows HbA1c 7.2, what does that mean?
What is the normal dose of paracetamol for an adult?
Difference between viral and bacterial fever symptoms
Can I take ibuprofen with high blood pressure?
Explain this ECG finding: ST elevation in leads II, III and aVF
What causes iron deficiency anaemia and how is it treated?
What is the first aid for a snake bite?
Explain my thyroid report: TSH 6.8
What vaccines does a newborn need in the first year?
What are the warning signs of a stroke?
Is it safe to take amoxicillin during pregnancy?
How is dengue different from malaria?
roles.note: Small medical models (MedGemma 4B, II-Medical 8B, HuatuoGPT) are beaten by Qwen3.5-4B/9B; open specialists only pull ahead at 27B and up.

roles.title: finance, accounting and tax
roles.description: Accounting, bookkeeping, tax (GST, income tax), financial statements, investing and business finance.
examples: How do I calculate input tax credit under GST?
Prepare a journal entry for goods purchased on credit for 50,000 plus 18% GST
What is the difference between old and new income tax regime?
Explain depreciation by the written down value method
How do I read a balance sheet?
What is the due date for GSTR-3B filing?
Calculate the EMI on a 20 lakh loan at 9% for 15 years
What is TDS on rent payments?
Explain the difference between cash and accrual accounting
How is capital gains tax calculated on selling shares held for 2 years?
Reconcile these bank entries with the ledger
What is working capital and how is it calculated?
Should reverse charge apply to legal services from an advocate?
What is a debit note in GST?
roles.note: No open finance or tax specialist beats a same-size general model, and none exists for Indian GST or income tax (2026-10). The brain answers; figures are checked in code.

roles.title: natural sciences
roles.description: Physics, chemistry, biology and other natural sciences: concepts, reactions, mechanisms, experiments.
examples: Balance this equation: Fe + O2 -> Fe2O3
Explain how photosynthesis works
What is the SMILES string for aspirin?
Why does ice float on water?
Explain the Krebs cycle
What is the half-life of carbon-14 and how is carbon dating done?
Describe the mechanism of an SN2 reaction
What is the difference between DNA and RNA?
Calculate the pH of a 0.01 M HCl solution
Explain quantum tunnelling simply
What happens in mitosis?
How does a transistor amplify a signal?
Predict the product of ethanol with acidified potassium dichromate
roles.note: For general science Qwen3.5-9B (GPQA 81.7) beats every open specialist; chemistry specialists (Intern-S1, ether0) win only on narrow structured tasks. The brain answers.

roles.title: translation
roles.description: Translating text between languages, including Indian languages and English.
examples: Translate to Hindi: Please submit the documents by Friday
Translate this to English: मुझे कल बैंक जाना है
Translate into Tamil: Your payment has been received
What does kripya dhyan dein mean in English?
Translate this paragraph from Marathi to English
Translate to French: The meeting is postponed to next week
Convert this Hinglish message to formal English: bhai invoice bhej do jaldi
Translate into Bengali: Thank you for your order
Translate this Gujarati text into Hindi
How do you say where is the railway station in Kannada?
Translate the following legal notice into Telugu
Translate to Spanish: Our office will be closed on Monday

models.title: VibeThinker 1.5B
models.basis: Field research of 2026-10-24 (HF API checked; vendor numbers unless marked independent). AIME25 74.4, HMMT25 50.4 (vendor) vs Qwen3.5-2B HMMT25 22.9: far better than the same-size general model, nowhere near the frontier (GPT-5.5 AIME26 100). A reasoning model: long thoughts, slow on a CPU. Not for tools or agents.

models.title: Nanbeige 4.2 3B

models.title: flash-sqlite (Qwen3.5-2B for SQL)
